name: Capital Small Finance Bank Ltd
title: Capital Small Finance Bank Ltd - 544120 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 NIM rose to 4.06% and cost of deposits fell to 5.75%, but credit cost guided 0.15–0.25% with agri NPAs sticky at 2.76% and PCR raised to 51.89%.

triggers.label: NIM 4.01% → 4.06% (Q4)
triggers.quote: NIM showing early signs of improvement and improved to 4.06% in Q4 FY '26 versus 4.01% in Q3 FY '26

triggers.label: Cost of deposit 5.86% → 5.75%
triggers.quote: cost of deposit for the quarter has declined to 5.75% against 5.86% a quarter back

triggers.label: Credit cost 0.26%, PCR 51.89%
triggers.quote: Credit cost for the quarter stood at 0.26% and is consequent to enhanced PCA ratio to 51.89%

triggers.label: Advances +21% YoY to ₹8,687 cr
triggers.quote: Gross advances at ₹8,687 crores, registering 21% year -on-year growth

guidance.quote: we plan to organically grow our secured loan book at the rate of 22% plus for FY '27
achieve an advanced book of over ₹16,000 crores by FY '29
we are targeting ROA of 1.35% to 1.4% in FY '27
we are targeting ROA of 1.6% plus in FY '29
it will be range bound between 0.15% to 0.25% for FY '27
we intend to keep it between 2.9% to 2.95% or 2.9% to 3%

guidance.value: 235 by end of FY27; 300+ by FY29
guidance.quote: a target of 235 branches by the end of the current year and making it 300 plus by FY '29
we continue to believe this number to remain towards 0.85% to 0.95% in the coming period
We want to keep our credit cost downward to 0.3% up to FY '29

red_flags.label: Agri NPA sticky at 2.76%
red_flags.quote: NPA were almost static, that is 2.75% and 2.76%, respectively

red_flags.label: Yield on advances down ~30bp QoQ, partly reversals
red_flags.quote: So another 8 to 10 basis point impact is due to -- because this is the period in which the agri accounts become NPAs

red_flags.label: Interest reversals depress NII
red_flags.quote: there are slight interest reversals of ₹1 crores or ₹2 crores which is the factor which is bringing it down

evasions.quote: I believe it will be too early and too premature for me to comment how the monsoon will look like
I'm not having a handy number, so I can't comment upon that number at least with that authority
